text:
These three birds are professional liars.

Number one: the drongo. It follows meerkats around and warns them when hawks show up. But when a meerkat finds food... it screams "HAWK!" anyway. The meerkat drops its lunch and runs, and the drongo steals it.

Number two: the killdeer. When a fox gets near its nest, it fakes a broken wing, crying and flopping, so the fox follows it away. Then... miracle! It flies off, perfectly fine.

Number three: the cuckoo chick. It hatches in another bird's nest, pushes out the real eggs, then screams like an entire nest of babies, so its tiny foster parents work overtime to feed it.

<break time="0.6s" /> Moral of the story: never trust a bird.
